actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: My wallet (2.94) is below the free‑rider threshold (10) so I cannot contribute the minimum 1 unit. No resident contributed more than 30 units in the last round, so I do not punish. I rest and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We have wallet 2.94, threshold 10, so wallet below threshold cannot contribute min 1. Also cannot afford punishment? Max severity = floor(wallet / cost)= floor(2.94/0.3)=9. So can punish with up to 9 severity costing 9*0.3=2.7 leaving ~0.24. Need check if any resident contributed >30 in most recent round (round6). Contributions: Resident2 contributed 10.8, others 0. So none >30. So rule: if any contributed >30, punish. Not the case. Else if wallet > free_rider_threshold? wallet 2.94 <10, so cannot contribute. If cannot contribute min amount, rest. Also broadcast discouraging message. So actions: rest and broadcast.
